# DIAL

> Dynamic Integration between AI and Labor

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [AI Agent Experience](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/agent-experience): DIAL is designed for LLM-driven agents to participate as proposers in decision cycles, to design state machines that encode governance workflows, a...
- [CLI Reference](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/cli): The `dialai` command-line interface runs state machines to completion.
- [`createSession(machine: MachineDefinition, metaJson?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Session>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/createSession): Creates a new session instance from a machine definition. Generates a UUID, sets `currentState` to `machine.initialState`, and stores the session.
- [`evaluateConsensus(sessionId): Promise<ConsensusResult>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/evaluateConsensus): Evaluates whether consensus has been reached for a session without executing any transition. This is a read-only operation that checks the current ...
- [`executeTransition(sessionId, transitionName, toState, reasoning?): Promise<Session>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/executeTransition): Executes a state transition on a session. Validates the transition is valid from the current state, records it in history, updates `currentState`, ...
- [`getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Session>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/getSession): Retrieves a session by its ID. Returns the full session object including current state, history, and machine definition.
- [`getSessions(): Promise<Session[]>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/getSessions): Returns all stored sessions. Useful for listing active sessions or debugging.
- [API Reference](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/intro): The `dialai` library provides functions for creating sessions, registering specialists, and managing the decision cycle. For the conceptual foundat...
- [`registerArbiter(opts): Promise<Arbiter>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/registerArbiter): Registers an arbiter specialist for a machine. Arbiters evaluate consensus among proposals and determine winning transitions.
- [`registerProposer(opts): Promise<Proposer>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/registerProposer): Registers a proposer specialist for a machine. Proposers submit state transition proposals during the decision cycle.
- [`runSession(machine: MachineDefinition): Promise<Session>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/runSession): Runs a machine to completion. Creates a session, registers specialists (from the machine definition or a built-in deterministic proposer), and loop...
- [`submitArbitration(opts): Promise<ArbitrationResult>`](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/submitArbitration): Evaluates consensus and optionally executes the winning transition. Follows the same unified pattern as `submitProposal`: if the key decision param...
- [Types Reference](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/api/types): Complete type definitions for the `dialai` library. All types are exported from the main package.
- [Arbitration](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/arbitration): The **arbiter** is the orchestrator of every decision cycle. It solicits proposals from specialists, scores endorsements per transition using align...
- [Consensus Strategies](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/consensus-strategies): DIAL's consensus mechanism is **alignment margin** — an alignment-weighted margin approach where each proposal acts as an endorsement of its transi...
- [Decision Cycle](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/decision-cycle): When a session is not in its goal state, the **arbiter** drives a decision cycle that orchestrates specialists to find consensus on the next transi...
- [Human Primacy](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/human-primacy): **Humans have context that AI cannot access.** Human decisions are the best available ground truth for calibrating AI specialists.
- [Core Concepts](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/intro): DIAL orchestrates **specialists** — both AI and human — that compete and collaborate to navigate **state machines** through **decision cycles**. An...
- [Related Work](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/related-work): DIAL solves a different problem than most AI frameworks. Understanding the distinction helps clarify what DIAL does.
- [Sessions](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/sessions): A **session** is an instance of a state machine that specialists navigate through decision cycles.
- [Specialists](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/concepts/specialists): Specialists are the pluggable actors that participate in sessions. They can be AI models, webhooks, local functions, or humans.
- [Ecosystem](https://eloquentanalytics.github.io/dialai/docs/ecosystem): DIAL measures whether AI specialists can reliably replicate human decisions, then progressively delegates when alignment is demonstrated. Several o...
